answer: Make every new agent burn a fixed amount of a scarce external token to mint its identity, written to a public ledger. Each mint sends one visible ripple across that ledger; a sybil fleet of a thousand masks must each pay the same irreversible toll, so the attacker's total cost rises linearly into a steep saffron ridge of spent value that no duplication can fake, while an honest solo agent pays the toll once and moves on.
